description: An Aserai cream floor-length gown in fine opaque layered fabric, with a low square neckline, naturally fitted bodice and elbow sleeves. Gold geometric embroidery frames neckline, waist, cuffs, front and hem. Small round gold clasps secure the upper straps and belt, and an ochre-gold embroidered wrap rests along the arms. Gold earrings, pendant necklace, bracelets and rings add restrained minor-lord ornament. A modest below-knee walking opening and decorated gold flat shoes complete the outfit.
